title: recoverRuns writes the run map under the manager lock
lead: recoverRuns (internal/daemon/runs.go:118-157) writes d.runs.runs in its loop (:143-152) without the manager lock, then takes the lock only for startQueuedLocked (:153-155). It is safe today only because it runs before the server starts (daemon.go:176). Noted in the S05 run report.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Every other write to the run map happens under d.runs.mu. A later change that calls recoverRuns after the server starts would race.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/daemon/runs.go`: recoverRuns (:118-157).
- `internal/daemon/runs_test.go`: a test, if one can show the write is locked.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - TestRecoverRunsWritesTheRunMapUnderTheLock: under go test -race, a goroutine reads d.runs.runs under d.runs.mu while recoverRuns writes it; the race detector reports no race. Confirm the test fails (a race report) with the lock removed.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Take d.runs.mu around each write to d.runs.runs in the recoverRuns loop (runs.go:118-157), not around Reconcile (it can be slow). Write the race test first, watch it fail under -race, then add the lock. Decided 2026-10-23 (owner interview): take the lock. Nothing is open.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test -race -count=1 ./internal/daemon/...`
- `go test -race -count=1 ./...`
- `go vet ./...`
- `gofmt -l .` (prints nothing)
- `slicer check`
- `adj lint`
